classification: authored engineering calibration for the January 1991 start; NOT real observations. Engine units stay re-based to the Great Lakes 2000 dollar so West Germany 1991 sits near the shared wage level, which is also what the re-based currency ledger assumes. Coal and steel are dear against the shared base (a protected, shrinking industry), oil is moderate after the Gulf war spike, power is a little dear, chemicals and plastics are somewhat cheaper, and building materials are dear in the reunification construction boom.
